purpose: Infrastructure-only recovery of the already frozen Phase I-B XAUUSD M1/M5 2024-2025 dataset from canonical FundedNext-Server 2 local HCC minute-history files after MT5 Python chart-history and tick-history retrieval paths failed.
source_semantics: MT5 HCC files are the terminal's canonical one-minute history database for the named trade server and symbol. HCC bar datetime is retained directly as the MT5 server-time datetime coordinate, matching the Phase I-A MT5 Economic Calendar trade-server-time coordinate; no UTC/server offset transformation is permitted in this recovery path.

derived_timeframes.M5: deterministic 5-minute aggregation from recovered M1: open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last, tick_volume=sum, spread=last, real_volume=sum

frozen_news_mask: Phase I-A high-impact USD +/-5 minutes, unchanged
integrity_gates: exact canonical server/path provenance matches Phase I-A
valid positive OHLC and high/low envelope
minimum monthly and total coverage from existing Phase I-B checker
M5 exact-open timestamps must be a subset of M1 timestamps
news-clean output contains zero overlap with Phase I-A mask
existing build_xau_news_clean_dataset_v1_00.py and check_xau_news_clean_dataset_v1_00.py must both succeed
